deepest.songTitle: The First Cut Is the Deepest
deepest.line: The first cut is the deepest
stanza: The first cut is the deepest, baby, I know
The first cut is the deepest
'Cause when it comes to bein' lucky, she's cursed
When it comes to lovin' me, she's worst
But when it comes to bein' loved, she's first
The first cut is the deepest, baby, I know
The first cut is the deepest
